+title: 'Elicitation phase 6, task 52: keep an accepted URL elicitation in awaitingURLCompletions until elicitation/complete'
+---
+Source: request of the step owner.
+
+Defect today: `acceptElicitation` removes a URL elicitation, so a later `elicitation/complete` of the agent finds no match in `ModelClient.elicitationComplete`.
+
+Work:
+- After `acceptElicitation` of a URL elicitation, keep it in a public `awaitingURLCompletions` list on SessionModel and on ConnectionModel.
+- Remove it on `elicitation/complete`, on `cancel(meta:)`, on `cancelAllPending()`, on close, and on a new public `stopWaiting(_:)`.
+- `stopWaiting(_:)` sends nothing to the agent in v1.
+- Tests in fixed order for each path, with no time limit, sleep, poll or retry.
+- One full run. Push together with task 51, after the CI run of 682e997 ends.
+
+#elicitation-phase-6
\ No newline at end of file

+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m51ww19yexa8hy6rs1ft91rm
+  text: |-
+    ### implement — changed (reading accepted; Q3 yes)
+    - `awaitingURLCompletions: [PendingElicitation]` (public internal(set)) on SessionModel and on ConnectionModel. `acceptElicitation` of a url-mode elicitation answers the agent as before and moves the item there, with the same id.
+    - `completeElicitation(elicitationId:)` on both models matches a pending item (as before) or an awaiting item; an awaiting match removes it and sends nothing. ConnectionModel asks the sessions first, so ModelClient reports "matched" for a session item too.
+    - New public `stopWaiting(_:)` on both models; it sends nothing.
+    - SessionModel removes awaiting items on `cancel(meta:)`, `cancelAllPending()` and `markClosed()` (through cancelAllPending).
+    - ConnectionModel removes awaiting items at the finish of their client request (Q3), at a close and at a new connection.
+    - Tests: new suite `SessionModelURLCompletionTests` (10 tests), and 7 new tests in `ConnectionModelElicitationTests` (MARK URL completion).
